newsitem.title: USA: Hi-Lo Automotive Inc avoids proxy fight.
newsitem.headline: Hi-Lo Automotive Inc avoids proxy fight.

text.p: Hi-Lo Automotive Inc said Friday that the Hwang Family Ltd. Partnership group notified it that it no longer intends to solicit proxies for the election of its proposed nominees to Hi-Lo's board of directors.

The company said that the Hwang partnership group had previously said it would nominate and solicit proxies in favor of three dissident nominees. The partnership, said a company spokesman, had pressed for a sale of the company.
But the spokesman said that it was the intention of management now to run the business well, rather than try and sell it. He declined to say why the partnership had withdrawn its slate of candidates.
All of the company's current directors have been nominated for reelection, and Hi-Lo's annual meeting will take place May 20.

Hi-Lo, sells automotive aftermarket parts, products and accessories to retail and commercial customers through its 189 stores in Texas, Louisiana and California. It had $250 million in revenues in 1996.
